Goods and services are allocated by the community according to need, since ration and provision tie citizens to the regime (Collective Distribution). Modern industry and science are embraced to strengthen the racial heritage, so that machines and weapons serve the ruling people (Reactionary Modernism). The army leads the state, because soldiers and the security services stand above civilians (Stratocracy). The nation is defined by race and its purity, since the ruling people is set above others (Racial Nationalism). The empire keeps apart from outside powers, because it dominates its own sphere without partners (Isolationism). Technological development is inevitable and unavoidable, since the empire's engineers bring a future that nothing can stop (Techno-Fatalism). The state absorbs the individual, leaving no private sphere, because the person belongs to the empire (Totalism). All decision-making is concentrated wholly in the capital, with uniformity suppressing regional difference, so that Berlin commands all (Hypercentralism). Safeguarding privacy, speech and due process is rejected, because individual rights obstruct the security apparatus (against Civil Libertarianism). The protection of individual rights and expression is rejected since personal freedom weakens the whole (against Civil Liberalism). Consensual adult conduct without moral guidance is rejected, because the regime enforces conformity (against Permissivism). A single human community beyond nations is rejected since the racial empire rules rather than joins (against Cosmopolitanism). A worldview grounding ethics in human reason and dignity is rejected because the regime puts race and the state above the human person (against Secular Humanism). Recognizing coexisting communities as equals is rejected, since the ruling race holds the state (against Multiculturalism). Disarmament and nonviolent settlement are rejected because the empire rests on war and the army (against Pacifism).

Russian Imperial Cult.d: The state owns and runs major enterprises within a market economy, because the tsar's treasury and strategic industries serve the crown (State Capitalism). Very high taxes take wealth and income above a ceiling, since the sovereign may draw on the fortunes of subjects for the throne (Confiscatory Taxation). Public life is subordinated to Orthodox doctrine and tradition, because the church sanctifies the empire (Religious Traditionalism). A hereditary monarch holds supreme authority without limit, so that the anointed tsar is the sacred source of law (Absolute Monarchy). Government is ruled by clergy and divine law, since the church and the throne are joined as one holy order (Theocracy). The nation is defined by ethnicity and shared descent, because the Russian people is the carrier of the imperial mission (Ethnic Nationalism). The empire keeps apart from foreign powers, since the Third Rome needs no partners (Isolationism). Factories, railways and heavy industry expand material abundance, because the tsar's might rests on industry (Industrialism). Public etiquette and discipline are enforced, so that order and obedience mark the holy empire (Disciplinarianism). All decision-making is concentrated wholly in the capital, with uniformity suppressing regional difference, since one will rules from the throne (Hypercentralism). A worldview grounding ethics in reason without revelation is rejected because the faith, not the human mind, is the measure of right (against Secular Humanism). Safeguarding privacy, speech and due process is rejected since individual rights threaten the sacred order (against Civil Libertarianism). Consensual adult conduct without moral guidance is rejected, because sin must be restrained by throne and altar (against Permissivism). Recognizing coexisting communities with separate customs as equals is rejected since the empire has one faith and one people (against Multiculturalism). A single human community beyond nations is rejected because the holy Russian empire is unique among peoples (against Cosmopolitanism).
